name: agent_desktop
description: Observe and interact with Linux desktop application windows via native AT-SPI OS accessibility trees and semantic @refs without vision models.

action.description: The desktop action to perform via AT-SPI accessibility engine.

app.description: Optional application name to scope snapshot (e.g. 'chrome', 'nemo', 'terminal').

window_id.description: Optional window ID to scope snapshot (from list_windows).

ref.description: Target @ref ID from accessibility tree snapshot (e.g. '@s201xook5z7c16:e13').

text.description: Text payload to type into targeted @ref input field.

interactive_only.description: Filter snapshot to interactive elements only (-i flag). Defaults to true.
